name: CorpFlowAI — Active Agent Exception Supervisor v1 (TEMPLATE, INACTIVE, SECRET-FREE)

meta.note: Exception-only supervision. NO routine still-running / unchanged / old-PR-age noise. NO CREDENTIALS in repo.

parameters.content:
## Active Agent Exception Supervisor v1 (#661)

**Inactive by design.**

Polls control-loop report artifact path or factory endpoint integrator.

**ALERT ONLY:**
- activation failure
- stale run (actionable recovery)
- failed tests (review handoff)
- blocked protected decision
- cost threshold breach
- client-ready awaiting review
- control-loop evaluation failure

**NEVER ALERT:**
- routine still-running
- unchanged runs (followUpSentAt set)
- old PR age alone

Env in n8n ONLY:
- CORPFLOW_MONITOR_BASE_URL
- CORPFLOW_CRON_SECRET
- TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID (Anton gates only)
- GITHUB_TOKEN (optional #249 comment)

Wire Telegram node here.

Use TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_ALERT_CHAT_ID from n8n credentials.

Body: exception list (max 8 lines).

Do NOT page for routine cursor still-running.

Wire GitHub issue comment node.

Post to CORPFLOW_DISPATCHER_GITHUB_ISSUE (default 249).

Prefix: **Active-agent exception supervisor**
